summary: Streams audio samples from input a5 to an output via a sub-struct v7 at this+0x19C, handling partial reads with a single-sample buffer. When the pending flag at v7+0x24 is set, flushes the buffered sample through F_2DArrayBlockCopy and clears the flag. Otherwise computes how many samples to advance (1 or 2, clamped by remaining count v7+0x2C and the a7 - *a6 budget), reads one or two source samples, and dispatches them through the indirect function pointer at v7+0xC. Always advances *a6 by v9 and decrements the remaining count v7+0x2C; when no sample was buffered, advances the stream pointer *a3.

local_names.v7: audio stream sub-struct pointer read from this+0x19C
local_names.a3: in/out stream cursor pointer, advanced when no sample is buffered
local_names.a6: in/out sample counter, advanced by v9
local_names.a7: total remaining sample budget for this call
local_names.v9: number of samples consumed this call (1 or 2, clamped)
local_names.v12: stack sample-pair value passed to the dispatch function pointer
local_names.v13: second sample value read from the input buffer

operations.description: Load v7 = *(this + 0x19C), the audio stream sub-struct pointer
If the pending-sample flag at v7 + 0x24 (offset 0x24) is non-zero, flush the buffered sample; otherwise read fresh samples
Set v9 = 1 for the flush path
Call F_2DArrayBlockCopy (0x0051593F) with the pending-sample buffer at v7 + 0x20, destination a5 + 4 * *a6, and the block-copy size at v7 + 0x28
Clear the pending flag at v7 + 0x24 to 0
If the remaining count at v7 + 0x2C (offset 0x2C) is less than 2, clamp v9 down to that remaining count
Compute v14 = a7 - *a6 and clamp v9 to it (v9 = min(v9, v14))
Read the first source sample v12 = *(a5 + 4 * *a6)
If v9 <= 1, buffer the single pending sample: store the value from v7 + 0x20 into v13 and set the pending flag at v7 + 0x24 to 1
Otherwise read the second sample v13 = v11[1] from the input buffer
Dispatch the sample pair through the indirect function pointer at v7 + 0xC (offset 0xC), called with (a1, a2, *a3, &v12)
Decrement the remaining count at v7 + 0x2C by v9
If the pending flag at v7 + 0x24 is still zero (nothing buffered this call), advance the stream cursor *a3 by 1
Return result: a3 when the stream cursor was advanced, otherwise the F_2DArrayBlockCopy / dispatch call result
